original_statement:
What did you do? List the exact steps to reproduce, in order. src/HubCustodian.sol line 2 reads 'pragma solidity ^0.8.37;'. src/ArmadaNitroAdjudicator.sol reads 'pragma solidity 0.8.17;'.
What did you expect to happen? src/HubCustodian.sol pins one exact solc version. Checks: (a) behavior: 'python3 scripts/check-pragmas.py' prints JSON {hubcustodian_pragma: "<version>", hubcustodian_pragma_exact: true}; (b) grep_absent: pattern '\^0.8' in src/HubCustodian.sol.
What actually happened? Include the exact error text or output. HubCustodian's pragma is ^0.8.37.
Which surface or component? (e.g. gateway route, mobile screen, CLI verb) src/HubCustodian.sol
What environment and version? (OS, app/gateway build or commit, network) armada-nitro integrated; forge
Is it reproducible? (always / intermittently / once) — and how often. always
What is the impact / severity? Who is blocked and how badly? HubCustodian's bytecode depends on whichever solc at or above 0.8.37 the build resolves; the adjudicator pins 0.8.17.
What activity was underway when this was found? (ODC Activity — e.g. testing, code review, normal usage, reproduction attempt) design review for E11
What condition or event exposed the defect? (ODC Trigger — e.g. a config change, concurrent access, a boundary/edge-case input, an unusual workload) reading pragmas
restatement: src/HubCustodian.sol currently declares a floating compiler pragma, `pragma solidity ^0.8.37;`, which lets a build resolve any solc release from 0.8.37 up to (but not including) 0.9.0. This is inconsistent with src/ArmadaNitroAdjudicator.sol, which pins one exact compiler version, `pragma solidity 0.8.17;`. The request is that src/HubCustodian.sol be changed to pin one exact solc version in its own pragma line, removing the caret range, so the contract always compiles with the same named compiler rather than whichever version a build happens to resolve.

restatement_clauses.text: src/HubCustodian.sol's pragma statement must pin one exact solc version, not a version range.
src/HubCustodian.sol must no longer contain the pattern '^0.8' anywhere in the file.

goal: Change the pragma line in src/HubCustodian.sol so it names one exact compiler version instead of a floating ^0.8.37 range.
acceptance_criteria: Opening src/HubCustodian.sol shows a pragma line that names one exact compiler version, written as plain numbers with no range symbol in front of it.
Searching src/HubCustodian.sol for the text '^0.8' finds no match anywhere in the file.
